datasource_configs.description: Test datasource: a small real subset of GWAS Catalog association and study rows, chosen to exercise every way the catalog packs multiple values into the MAPPED_GENE, MAPPED_TRAIT and MAPPED_TRAIT_URI columns (see tests/data/test_gwas/README.md)

Test datasource: minimal stand-ins for the HGNC genes and EFO/MONDO traits the test_gwas associations reference, so the variant->gene edges (via Ensembl ids) and variant->trait / study->trait edges form in the isolated test_gwas subgraph (in production these come from the HGNC and OLS datasources)
